title: US equity markets closed — Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.
source: EST: the exchange's own calendar was BLOCKED to this runner — nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars returned HTTP 403 (4,543 bytes) on 2026-09-06, where the good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 sibling had read it at HTTP 200 a day earlier — so the prefix is honestly EST: rather than the NYSE-sourced NEWS: that sibling used, and the blockage is recorded in the proposing ledger's probe-ref.blocked array. What IS primary here: federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm (HTTP 200, 82,205 bytes, fetched direct 2026-09-06, page stamped 'Last Update: July 8, 2026'), the Fed's K.8 'Holidays Observed by the Federal Reserve System 2026-2030' table, whose 'Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr.' row parses across the year headers as January 19 / January 18 / January 17 / January 15 / January 21 for 2026 / 2027 / 2028 / 2029 / 2030 — i.e. 2027-01-18. Independently reproduced by the statute (5 U.S.C. 6103: third Monday in January): January 2027's Mondays are the 4th, 11th, 18th and 25th, so the third is 2027-01-18, a Monday. The NYSE separately observes MLK Day and has since 1998, but this session holds no NYSE primary saying so for 2027, and a Federal Reserve closure is not an exchange closure — that one-step gap, plus the 403 and the fact that this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, is exactly why this is filed estimate. The DATE of the federal holiday is not in doubt; the estimate label is about the exchange leg and the taxonomy. PROMOTION CRITERION: any NYSE or Cboe primary listing 2027-01-18 as a market closure. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: PROPOSED by the vix-expiration-2027-01-20 initial research (2026-09-06), at D-2 inside its five-day adjacency corridor. It is the closure the vix-expiration-2027-02-17 sibling explicitly NAMED and declined on 2026-09-05 ('deliberately not proposed: mlk-market-closure-2027-01-18 ... out of corridor'); it is in corridor here, so this lane files it. Same class as good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26, presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 and memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31, and it inherits that class's honest limit verbatim: EventKind has no member for an exchange-schedule event, so 'sector' is the least-wrong option rather than a right one. WHY A SHUT DAY EARNS A ROW, and the reason is measured rather than decorative. (1) It makes the VIX settlement week a FOUR-session week -- Tue 01-19, Wed 01-20 (VIX/VXM SOQ), Thu 01-21, Fri 01-22 (boj-decision-2027-01-22 + japan-cpi-2027-01-22) -- putting the volatility settlement and a central-bank decision into four sessions, with the SOQ as the week's second session. (2) The finding the proposer actually banks: 2027-01-18 falls in the five-day hole between VX/Z6's 30-day strip (2026-12-17 -> 2027-01-15) and VX/F7's (2027-01-21 -> 2027-02-19), which makes it the ONLY US market closure interior to the listed VIX curve's span (2026-09-17 -> 2027-06-17) that NO listed VIX future's settlement window contains -- computed this session against all nine listed VX contracts. Every other closure in that span sits inside exactly one strip (Thanksgiving 2026-11-26 in X6, Christmas 2026-12-25 and New Year 2027-01-01 both in Z6, Washington's Birthday 2027-02-15 in F7, Good Friday 2027-03-26 in H7, Memorial Day 2027-05-31 in K7). Consequence, stated as a refusal: the business-time drag mechanic three sessions of this lane have now measured cannot attach to this closure at all, so 'January has MLK, therefore the January VIX contract is drag-cheapened' is FALSE -- VX/F7's 21-session strip comes from a FEBRUARY holiday. (3) It also sits three sessions after opex-2027-01-15 and two days after fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16. Impact LOW and structural: a closed session moves nothing by itself, no house playbook is calendar-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md grepped this session for opex|expiration|witching|volatility settlement|SOQ -- zero hits in both), and it changes how many sessions the surrounding flows clear in, never direction. Deliberately NOT proposed alongside it: the remaining 2027 NYSE closures (out of corridor -- filing the whole year here would manufacture research burden this run cannot justify) and vix-expiration-2026-12-16 (101 days out, far outside this corridor). SEPARATELY OBSERVED, not fixed here: the calendar carries BOTH presidents-day-market-closure-2027-02-15 and washingtons-birthday-market-closure-2027-02-15 for the same single NYSE closure -- two ids for one day, neither of them this lane's file to touch.
